system.description:
Your strength daunts even other Cainites; few would dare cross you in a contest of raw physical power.

Might grants a single retest on any challenge of sheer physical strength — grappling, lifting a heavy object, breaking something. Once invoked it is the final test of the challenge, allowing no further retests, and it costs nothing to use. You may use Might even against an opponent trying to evade your strength with stamina or quickness, so long as you rely solely on strength (generally by bidding a strength-related Trait). You cannot use Might at range or with a thrown object, which depend on speed and accuracy; you may use it while grabbing at a dodging opponent, but not when picking up and hurling a heavy object.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
